drums.tags: Funk-rock fusion featuring a prominent, syncopated electric bass guitar as the lead melodic and rhythmic voice. The bass utilizes a mix of fingerstyle plucking, percussive slaps, and pops, often doubling the kick drum patterns. A clean electric guitar provides rhythmic stabs and muted scratches on the off-beats. The drum kit maintains a steady backbeat with a crisp snare and tight hi-hat work, occasionally incorporating ghost notes. The arrangement is centered around a repetitive, groovy bass riff that undergoes slight variations in intensity and phrasing. The production is dry with minimal reverb, emphasizing the percussive attack of the strings. Key: E minor. Tempo: 105 BPM.

bass.tags: Drum solo and percussion performance. The track features a standard acoustic drum kit including a punchy kick drum, crisp snare, hi-hats, and multiple crash and ride cymbals. The performance begins with a series of rhythmic exercises and rudiments, transitioning into a high-tempo rock beat. It features complex syncopation, rapid double-stroke rolls on the snare, and aggressive cymbal crashes. The recording has a dry, close-mic'd studio aesthetic with minimal room reverb. The tempo fluctuates between 120 and 140 BPM as the drummer explores different subdivisions and fills.
